concerns.text: FR-004 requires comparing 'the generated execution plan' (the SUT/router plan, which the spec's scope assumption says is simulated by a lightweight script) against the ground-truth plan. No task implements the SUT plan generator. T024 says 'Binary translation-error comparison (FR-004) ... against T007 ground truth' — only one side of the comparison exists, so translation_error cannot be computed without inventing logic at implementation time. This silently weakens FR-004/US-2 scenario 1.

US-2 scenario 2 requires 'a set of 100 high-complexity graph queries' for the error-rate comparison. T021 only requires ≥30 queries across all source types; T037 says 'the complete 500-query set' without defining per-depth/per-source composition. No task guarantees the 100 high-complexity graph queries, so this acceptance criterion is dropped.

T013's contract test validates ExecutionMetric against execution_metric.schema.yaml, which REQUIRES mismatch_flag, delta_latency, engine_version, and throttle_config — fields no task produces and which are absent from execution_logs.csv (T021's column list). FR-003's entity is being validated against a legacy shape its tasks never emit; the test as specified cannot pass without weakening or the schema being corrected.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T004, T018, T020 vs contracts/analysis_result.schema.yaml and gam_results.schema.yaml
concerns.text: T004 creates analysis_result.schema.yaml (requiring mean_delta_latency, std_delta_latency, segmented_regression_knee_point, per source_type/complexity_category grouping) but T018 writes the different anova_results.json structure from data-model.md and no task validates against it; gam_results.schema.yaml (LMM/Jonckheere) has no implementing task. Orphaned contracts either need a producing task or explicit removal to avoid a false validation gate.

FR-003 and US-1 scenario 1 state each latency record is 'a JSON object'; T021 persists to execution_logs.csv only. Either add a JSON-lines artifact or reconcile the spec wording — as written, the task's deliverable does not match the FR's stated format (content fields are all present, so this is a format-reconciliation issue, not a data gap).
